title: Oven Baked Irish Sun Dried Tomatoes Flatbread
description: A delicious and satisfying Irish dish featuring sun dried tomatoes, perfect for a midnight craving, this flexitarian friendly flatbread is yeasty and light.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine warm flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add olive oil to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Spread chopped sun dried tomatoes, minced garlic, and chopped rosemary over the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle shredded mozzarella cheese over the top of the flatbread.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
